name: qf_device
character: The device that controls people, heard once in the lab and once at the end: a sub pulse under a thin carrier near 3 kHz that wobbles at 7.5 Hz and creeps upward, never resolving.
note: A 41 Hz tone with a slow 1 Hz swell, and a carrier at 1.85 kHz amplitude-modulated at 7.5 Hz; the carrier rises by a third of an octave over the last nine seconds; the cue is not a signal to any real system. ESTIMATE: the pulse and carrier frequencies and the levels are starting values
